title: Dilemma
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji and Ye Qing were sealing their pact with a clap of hands, Chen Nian, deep within the Holy Sect's secret realm, suddenly opened her eyes—in those eyes so identical to Chen Ji's, the aura of Heavenly Fate was fluctuating violently.

text.content: The aura of the Demonic Path envoy pressed upon the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate like a physical force. Chen Ji's clenched fists trembled slightly, yet not from fear. His divine sense pierced through the layers of halls, clearly capturing that familiar yet foreign demonic presence—Ye Qing's unique cold aura, carrying a heart-stopping oppression. "They've come faster than I anticipated." Chen Ji murmured to himself, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea grew slightly hot, and a line of blurred prophecy emerged: In three days, the Holy Sect will face great upheaval. He understood—this was the final window of opportunity.

Returning to his dilapidated servant's quarters, Chen Ji bolted the door and sat cross-legged on the meditation cushion. In his Mental Sea, the Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfurled, its yellowed surface revealing dense threads of karmic connections. He began deducing—the first path, infiltrating the Holy Sect's secret realm alone, with his current Foundation Building initial stage cultivation, offered less than thirty percent success rate, and would certainly alert Ling Yuan, risking not only his failure to rescue Chen Nian but also destabilizing the Tianqing Sect's foundations. The second path, launching a direct assault using Tianqing Sect's full force, yet the three major sects had long shared a tacit understanding—once Tianqing Sect moved against the Holy Sect, both the Xuanwu Sect and White Tiger Sect would inevitably exploit the opportunity. The third path, biding time for a gradual approach, but every day of delay meant Chen Nian would lose more Heavenly Fate Value, and her body was already on its last legs...

Every path leads to the abyss, every choice accompanied by unbearable costs. Chen Ji closed his eyes, his fingertips gently tapping his knees as countless possibilities raced through his mind. His Heavenly Fate Value was less than a hundred points remaining, each glimpse of the future consuming precious five points, and these points were meant to be his final trump card for bridging the cultivation gap. "If there were intelligence..." he murmured. Just then, a subtle sound came from outside the window, followed immediately by a familiar cold voice at his ear: "Young Master Chen, it's been a while." Chen Ji's eyes snapped open to find a black-clothed figure standing by the window, moonlight outlining Ye Qing's enchanting eyes, now gazing at him with playful amusement.

choice.prompt: Facing Ye Qing's sudden appearance, Chen Ji needed to quickly judge her purpose—is she friend or foe?

choices.description: Present himself as a worthless servant to observe Ye Qing's true intentions
choices.visible_cost: Expose part of his disguise, buying time
choices.visible_reward: Obtain intelligence about Ye Qing's true intentions
choices.risk_hint: If judgment proves wrong, he may fall into a passive position

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, his body instinctively stepping back half a pace, knocking over the wooden bucket behind him. "You, who are you? How dare a Demonic Path member trespass the Tianqing Sect!" His voice trembled slightly, perfectly portraying the reaction of a cowardly servant who had been scared out of his wits. Upon seeing this, Ye Qing's smile deepened, her delicate hand raised, a strand of black spiritual energy gently closing the window. "Young Master Chen, your acting skills are becoming more refined. Unfortunately, you and I both know—" she leaned forward, the unique幽 cold fragrance of the Demonic Path wafting over him, "you never came to Tianqing Sect to be a servant, did you?"

choices.text: Laying cards on the table directly
choices.description: Face Ye Qing as an equal, candidly admitting he knows something about her
choices.visible_cost: Expose the trump card prematurely, reducing the aura of mystery
choices.visible_reward: Shorten negotiation time, gaining Ye Qing's trust
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing harbors ulterior motives, he will lose the initiative

text.content: "The Holy Sect's Saint Maiden gracing me with her presence, how unworthy I am." Chen Ji stood up, his expression calm as he met Ye Qing's gaze. "Miss Ye, has the Tianji Record's prophecy come true?" A flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's eyes, then transformed into deep solemnity. She had expected Chen Ji to continue playing dumb as before, never expecting him to be so candid. "You truly aren't afraid I'll report this to the sect?" Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying the composure of one who had the situation under control: "If Miss Ye truly wished to harm me, she could have struck when appearing at the sect gate earlier. Why visit in the dead of night? Speak—each of us gets what we need."

choices.description: While Ye Qing is still finding her footing, attack to test her true strength
choices.visible_cost: May damage cooperative relations, angering Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Obtain critical intelligence at the tactical level
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing's strength exceeds expectations, he will fall into a bitter battle

text.content: Before the words even finished, Chen Ji's right hand had already凝聚 a fierce sword qi, stabbing directly toward Ye Qing's face. This strike came without warning, even the air torn apart by a sharp hiss. Ye Qing's expression slightly changed, her figure ghost-like as she sidestepped half a step, the sword qi barely grazing her ear, cutting off a few strands of blue hair. "What a fast sword." She steadied herself, her gaze toward Chen Ji now carrying more solemnity and wariness. "Foundation Building initial stage yet such reaction speed—Young Master Chen truly conceals his depth." Chen Ji sheathed his sword and stood calmly: "Miss Ye's late-night visit, surely not merely to reminisce?"

Ye Qing laughed lightly, that laughter like silver bells, pleasant yet carrying an indescribable chill. "Young Master Chen's probing, Ye Qing accepts with gratitude." She withdrew a black jade slip from her sleeve, gently tossing it toward Chen Ji. "This is intelligence I risked my life to bring out from within the Holy Sect—news about your dear sister." Chen Ji took the jade slip, his divine sense probing within, his expression suddenly darkening. The jade slip contained records of the secret realm where Chen Nian was imprisoned, along with an important piece of information he had never anticipated: the Holy Sect's interior was far from united.

"The Holy Sect Master has been in seclusion for many years; in truth, the power is controlled by the three Supreme Elders." Ye Qing's voice echoed in the silent room. "My nominal father—the current Sect Master Ye Wugen—is merely a puppet stripped of real authority. This extraction ritual concerning the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' was orchestrated by Elder Chiyang, one of the three Supreme Elders. He seeks to break through his bottleneck and step into the Transformation God realm. As for me..." She paused, a complex emotion flickering in her eyes. "I am merely a chess piece in his hand, to be discarded at any moment."

After listening to Chen Ji, he fell into contemplation. The information in the Jade Slip made him realize that viewing the Holy Sect as a monolithic enemy had been a grave mistake. The three Supreme Elders each had their own schemes; Ye Wugen, though a puppet, might not lack ambition; and Ye Qing's position as Holy Maiden was walking on thin ice. "So you've come to me, wanting to use my hand to stir up the muddy waters of the Holy Sect?" Chen Ji raised his gaze, his eyes sharp as knives. "Smart." Ye Qing admitted without hesitation, "Young Master Chen wants to save your sister, and I want to escape Elder Chiyang's control—our enemies are the same. How about... cooperation?"

choice.prompt: Ye Qing proposes cooperation, and Chen Ji must weigh the pros and cons—how valuable is this intelligence? Can Ye Qing be trusted?

choices.description: Accept cooperation, but demand Ye Qing provide more leverage, including detailed defense maps of the secret realm
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more strategic intelligence to reduce operational risks
choices.risk_hint: May delay timing if Ye Qing cannot provide

text.content: "Cooperation is possible." Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his chest, his gaze calm and profound. "But I need more—the defense formation map of the secret realm's entrance, the guard rotation schedule updated every three days, and... Elder Chiyang's specific whereabouts." Upon hearing this, Ye Qing furrowed her brows slightly: "You're certainly asking for a lot." "Young Lady Ye, aren't you taking a huge risk by coming to find me? Don't you want a way out?" Chen Ji smiled faintly, "The intelligence I require might just be your final insurance before leaving the Holy Sect." The two stared at each other for a moment before Ye Qing finally nodded: "In three days, I'll deliver what you need to the designated location."

choices.memory_label: 陈机与夜清达成初步合作意向

choices.description: Exchange sincerity with sincerity, tell Ye Qing the cost of using the Tianji Record, strive to establish deep trust
choices.visible_cost: Expose the Tianji Record secret, increasing leak risks
choices.visible_reward: May unlock Ye Qing's hidden support
choices.risk_hint: If Ye Qing has ulterior motives, the bottom cards will be completely exposed

text.content: "Does Young Lady Ye know what price I must pay every time I foresee the future?" Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice low, "Heavenly Fate Value—this is the foundation the Tianji Record uses to maintain my spirit consciousness operation. Once depleted, not only will my foresight ability completely vanish, but this life of mine will also cease to exist." Ye Qing was stunned—she hadn't expected Chen Ji to voluntarily reveal such core secrets. "You... why tell me?" Chen Ji turned around, gazing at the moonlight outside the window: "Because you are my only ally at present. If even this level of trust isn't given, how can we fight side by side?"

choices.memory_label: 陈机向夜清坦诚天机录代价，两人关系质的飞跃

choices.visible_cost: Miss the best timing for deep cooperation
choices.visible_reward: Retain more bottom cards, reduce betrayal risk
choices.risk_hint: May anger Ye Qing, lose a key ally

text.content: "I've received the intelligence." Chen Ji tucked the Jade Slip into his sleeve, saying calmly, "But regarding cooperation, let me consider for a few days." Ye Qing's expression changed slightly, then she restored her bewitching smile: "Young Master Chen is indeed cautious. But I must remind you—in three days, Elder Chiyang will personally preside over the extraction ritual, and at that time, your sister's Heavenly Fate Value will be completely drained." She turned to leave but looked back: "Both of us are people with no freedom of choice. Rather than fighting fate alone, why not try standing together? I hope Young Master Chen will reconsider."

After Ye Qing left, Chen Ji stood alone by the window, gazing in the direction where she disappeared. The Tianji Record Fragment appeared once more in his Mental Sea, and this time, the prophecy was clearer than before: In three days, at the Holy Sect secret realm entrance, Elder Chiyang will personally preside over the extraction ritual, Ye Wugen will secretly appear, and mysterious forces will intervene... "Mysterious forces..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, his brow furrowed tightly. He suddenly realized this rescue operation was far more complex than he had imagined. Each of the three routes had its own dangers, and only three days remained. Rescuing Chen Nian was inevitable, but how to rescue, who to involve, what price to pay—these questions tangled in his heart like a mess of hemp rope.

Just then, a line of golden text suddenly appeared on the Tianji Record Fragment—it was Mo Xiansheng's voice: "Boy, this old man observed your hesitation and hereby bestows a strategy—dual-line advance. Rescuing your sister takes priority, this is the bright line; inciting rebellion within the Holy Sect's internal forces serves as support, this is the dark line. Only by intertwining bright and dark can one find a chance of survival in chaotic times." Chen Ji's eyes lit up. Though Mo Xiansheng always came and went like a mysterious dragon, every time he spoke, it carried significance. Dual-line advance—this was an approach Chen Ji hadn't considered before. If while rescuing Chen Nian he could also sway Ye Wugen or other factions dissatisfied with Elder Chiyang, he could create chaos within the Holy Sect, and at that time, fishing in troubled waters would greatly increase the success rate.

choice.prompt: The dual-line advance strategy is set, but the specific execution plan still requires choice—steady progress or taking risks?

choices.description: Collect intelligence systematically and prepare thoroughly within three days before taking action
choices.visible_cost: Time is pressing; we may miss the optimal moment
choices.visible_reward: Increased success rate of the operation, reduced variables of unexpected events
choices.risk_hint: If the enemy discovers the plan in advance, we will fall into a passive situation

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, suppressing the anxiety in his heart. Mo Xiansheng was right—haste makes waste. He took out a blank Jade Slip from under his pillow and began categorizing all the known intelligence: three entrances to the secret realm, each guarded by a Core Formation stage Elder; the rotation time is every day at midnight, lasting half an hour; Elder Chiyang's seclusion location is on the Holy Sect Main Peak, cultivation at least at the Nascent Soul early stage... Every piece of intelligence was carefully marked by him, ensuring all variables were considered before action. "Three days..." Chen Ji clenched his fist, "That's enough."

choices.description: Utilizing Ye Qing's cooperation, creating chaos at the ceremony's start, and rushing into the secret realm amid the confusion
choices.visible_cost: Extremely high risk, may trigger a multi-party melee
choices.visible_reward: Once successful, it will completely disrupt the enemy's arrangement
choices.risk_hint: If Chen Nian cannot be rescued amid the chaos, the consequences would be unimaginable

text.content: "Risk and reward coexist." A fierce glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Tianji Record's prophecy had already revealed the optimal timing—the very moment the ceremony begins, when all guards' attention is most scattered. If he could have Ye Qing create chaos from within at that moment, he could infiltrate the secret realm amid the confusion and rescue Chen Nian directly. As for the consequences... "At worst, it's a mutual destruction." Chen Ji murmured, his tone carrying unwavering resolve. He took out a communication Jade Symbol and sent a brief message to Ye Qing: "In three days, act as planned."

choices.description: Arrange Su Qingyao to create distractions within the sect to draw attention, while personally infiltrating the Holy Sect
choices.visible_cost: Requires consuming Su Qingyao's trust, may expose her position
choices.visible_reward: Can effectively disperse enemy attention and increase success rate
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao is exposed, we will lose an important support within the sect

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly thought of a key figure—Su Qingyao. This Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was extremely sharp and had long noticed his unusual behavior. Rather than letting her secretly investigate and sabotage the plan, he might as well turn the tables and make her his cover. "Su Senior Sister..." Chen Ji murmured, already having a plan in mind. He took out another Jade Symbol and began editing a message. In three days, the Inner Sect Tournament at Tianqing Sect Main Peak would commence—an excellent opportunity to attract the sect's attention. If Su Qingyao could 'accidentally' discover some information about the Demonic Path at this time, the entire Tianqing Sect's attention would be mobilized, and he could slip through the cracks. "

Just as Chen Ji was weighing the options, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly vibrated intensely, and an unprecedentedly clear prophecy emerged: At the ceremony site three days later, not only would Elder Chiyang and Ye Wuchen be present, but also Han Lie from the Xuanwu Sect—he was actually an invited VIP! "Han Lie..." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. This nemesis who had clashed with him several times would appear in the heart of the Holy Sect. Was this a coincidence, or was someone orchestrating events behind the scenes? Either way, it dramatically increased the complexity of this rescue operation. But at the same time, Chen Ji also saw opportunity—Han Lie was strong, but he had courage without wisdom. If he could exploit this weakness in the chaos..."

Chen Ji took a deep breath, rapidly deducing every possibility in his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a hint of approval: "The student is commendable. You have learned to find flaws in desperate situations—this is the true essence of strategy. Remember, the Tianji Record can only give you guidance; the real chess game requires you to place the pieces yourself." Chen Ji silently nodded. The moonlight outside the window had gradually sunk westward, and he knew he had to make the final decision before dawn. Three days... time was tight, but victory was not impossible. The dual-track strategy was set, the intertwined chess game was arranged, and now all that remained was to place every piece in its most suitable position.

He spread a blank spiritual paper, lifted his brush, and wrote all the details of the action in three days: The light strategy—rescue Chen Nian, the goal being to safely evacuate her from the secret realm; The dark strategy—turn members of the Holy Sect's internal forces, the goal being to create chaos and pin down Elder Chiyang; The variable—Han Lie's appearance, must find a way to utilize or avoid this powerhouse nemesis; The trump card—the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability, only to be used at the most critical moments, every prophecy must be used at the knife's edge. After writing the last character, Chen Ji set down his brush, a hint of resolve flickering in his gaze. "A'Nian, big brother is coming to save you." He whispered softly, his voice carrying unwavering tenderness. The Holy Sect secret realm three days later would surely stir up a storm that could shake the entire cultivation world. And he, Chen Ji, would personally ignite this fuse.

The last sliver of moonlight passed through the window lattice, illuminating Chen Ji's young yet scheming face. He carefully stored the written plan into his storage bag, then stood up and walked to the window. From the direction of the Tianqing Sect Mountain Gate, that demonic aura still loomed—Ye Qing had not left, or perhaps she was secretly observing his reaction. In any case, this chess game had reached its most critical moment. "Lin Yuan... Han Lie... Elder Chiyang..." Chen Ji called out each enemy's name one by one, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips, "Did you think I was just a useless Servant Disciple?" He turned and pushed open the door, striding into the depths of the night. He only had three days left, and he could hardly wait to see what expression would appear on the faces of these self-proclaimed Chess Players when the game was finally over.
